name: T&L Muumuu Factory
old_description: From flowing muʻumuʻu for everyday wear to hula needs, each piece is handcrafted in Hawaiʻi.
about:
For nearly four decades, T&L Muumuu Factory has carried on the tradition of garment making in Honolulu, Hawaii. The family-owned and operated business began as a small local shop and grew through word of mouth and lasting customer relationships. Today, the company continues to design, cut, and sew every piece in its Honolulu workshop, using original patterns that have guided generations of makers.

The product line centers on women's muumuus, aloha shirts sized up to 4X, and a children's collection of keiki tops, skirts, and dresses for both performance and everyday wear. Each garment is handcrafted in Hawaii, with the workshop handling design, pattern making, cutting, and sewing under one roof. The factory also offers alteration services, including same-day turnaround for retail customers.

Customers range from local residents and visitors seeking island-style apparel to hālau (hula schools) in Japan and groups ordering coordinated outfits for weddings and cultural events. The company specializes in custom orders, providing a streamlined communication process for bulk and made-to-measure requests. Free domestic shipping is available on orders over $200.

The business was founded to honor the craftsmanship and care that define island style, a mission that remains central to its operations. By preserving original patterns and maintaining hands-on production, T&L Muumuu Factory aims to support and perpetuate the cultural traditions behind Hawaiian garments, delivering each piece from their hands to the customer with the same attention that started it all.

name: T&R Tooling, LLC - Plastic Injection Molding Service Texas
old_description: T&R Tooling delivers end-to-end precision tooling and plastic injection molding solutions that let you manufacture with confidence — from design and production, to stocking and delivery.
about:
T&R Tooling, LLC operates from a 40,000-square-foot facility in Valley View, Texas. The company was founded by Tom and Ronney, two toolmakers who began with a small backyard shop in nearby Krum. Their partnership grew from a handshake and a shared belief that they could better serve customers together. The business remains family-owned.

The shop provides end-to-end plastic injection molding and custom tooling. Services span mold design and construction (both in-house and offshore), mold repair, optimization, and transfer, as well as low- to high-volume injection molding. Prototyping capabilities include 3D printing and CNC machining. Post-molding operations cover first-article inspection, assembly, packaging, hot-stamping, and inventory stocking programs. The facility houses 14 injection molding machines, eight machining centers, and an assembly department, supported by SolidWorks, Mastercam, and Fusion 360.

Customers come from aerospace, automotive, robotics, and other industrial sectors. Named references include Pinnacle Safety Products (safety equipment), North Texas Plastics, and Displays by Martin Paul, Inc. (display manufacturing).

The founders started T&R Tooling to deliver a seamless, stress-free experience from design to delivery. The company emphasizes guaranteed mold ownership, on-time delivery, proactive communication, and a craftsmanship-driven culture.

name: T1 Energy Inc.
old_description: T1 Energy (formerly FREYR Battery) is an Austin, Texas-headquartered manufacturer building domestic solar module and battery supply chains, with plants in Dallas and Austin.
about:
T1 Energy Inc., headquartered in Austin, Texas, operates as a manufacturer of solar photovoltaic modules and lithium‑ion battery cells. The company, formerly known as FREYR Battery, is building domestic solar and battery supply chains with production facilities in Dallas (G1) and Austin (G2). No founding year or ownership details are disclosed in the available sources.

The company produces solar modules using TOPCon N‑type cell technology, incorporating silicon nitride coating, atomic‑layer alumina front‑passivation, boron‑doped polysilicon regions, and screen‑printed silver/aluminum busbars. Battery cell manufacturing is in a planned expansion phase. Projected capacity for Q1 2026 includes 935 MW of module production and $250.1 million in net sales. Facility size and headcount are not publicly specified.

T1 Energy serves utility, residential, commercial, and grid‑storage markets. Concrete customer engagements include a strategic offtake agreement with Clearway and the acquisition of advanced solar intellectual property from Evervolt. The company also references a data‑center development project (Giga Arctic) indicating expansion into the data‑center energy segment.

The stated mission is to invigorate America with scalable, reliable, low‑cost energy by establishing domestic manufacturing capacity. The company emphasizes next‑generation industrial‑scale PV technology designed for maximum efficiency and longevity, leveraging abundant materials such as silicon, glass, and aluminum.

name: TDE Fab
old_description: custom metal railings, fireplaces, and more—crafted with precision, style, and strength for residential and commercial spaces across the Midwest.
about:
TDE Fabrication operates from Lakeland, Minnesota, near the Twin Cities metropolitan area. The company was founded by Andrew Tange and Jake Liedtke, both graduates of the University of Wisconsin system. Tange earned a bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering from UW–Milwaukee and developed a passion for metalworking and product invention, while Liedtke studied engineering at UW–Platteville before building a career in customer service and sales. Their combined backgrounds in engineering and design led them to establish a custom metalworking shop focused on architectural metal features.

The shop produces custom architectural metalwork for residential and commercial projects across the Midwest. Its portfolio includes floating staircases, interior and exterior railings, statement fireplace surrounds and mantels, pergolas and outdoor shade structures, and decorative metal panels. The team handles design renderings, site measurements, in-house fabrication, and final installation, offering a seamless process from concept to completion.

TDE Fabrication serves home builders, designers, architects, and general contractors throughout the Twin Cities region, including communities such as Minnetonka, Chanhassen, Stillwater, Wayzata, Edina, and Shakopee. The company collaborates with these professionals to deliver structural and decorative metal elements that integrate with broader building projects.

The founders emphasize four pillars that distinguish the business: every project receives a custom design tailored to the client's style and functional needs; craftsmanship combines advanced fabrication techniques with artisan-level attention to detail; a collaborative process keeps builders, designers, and contractors involved from concept through installation; and only premium metals and finishes are used to ensure lasting performance.

name: TKH Woodworking
old_description: Custom woodworking with a personal touch — built in Leonard, Michigan.
about:
TKH Woodworking operates from Leonard, Michigan, where owner Tim Monkevich opened the shop after a decade of woodworking passion. The business is family-owned and run as a sole proprietorship, with Monkevich handling every project personally.

The shop produces custom cutting boards, handcrafted furniture, cabinetry, bathroom vanities, mudroom benches, and bookshelves. All pieces are built from solid hardwood using traditional joinery — drawers feature dovetail construction — and are assembled with durable glues. The operation is a one-person workshop, so each item receives hands-on attention from design through final finish.

Customers are primarily homeowners seeking personalized pieces for their residences, along with gift buyers looking for custom cutting boards. Projects range from kitchen and bathroom cabinetry to one-of-a-kind furniture built to fit specific spaces and styles.

Monkevich emphasizes a direct, one-on-one experience grounded in honesty, clear communication, and respect. He describes himself as a perfectionist who aims to make every piece last a lifetime, differentiating the shop through personal service and a commitment to quality materials and joinery.

name: TREIF USA Inc
old_description: JBT Marel named one of America’s Greatest Workplaces for Culture, Belonging & Community 2026
about:
TREIF USA Inc, with its website at marel.com, is headquartered in Shelton, Connecticut. The company operates as JBT Marel, a global leader in advanced automation for the food and beverage industry.

JBT Marel designs and delivers a comprehensive portfolio that spans high-performing standalone machines to fully integrated, end-to-end processing lines. Its equipment solutions cover primary processing, further processing, refrigeration, and end-of-line packaging across protein, produce, and plant-based categories. Complementing the hardware, the company provides purpose-built food processing software that integrates machine, process, and business data to enable real-time insights, traceability compliance, and preventative maintenance. A global service network — 133 locations across 29 countries — offers lifetime support through service agreements, spare parts, and on-site expertise, anchored by Customer Technology Centers such as the Lakeland Customer Innovation Center where processors can trial technologies like the Flip & Wash bin washer.

The company serves a broad spectrum of food and beverage sectors, including poultry, meat, fish and seafood, prepared foods, ready meals, beverages and juices, fruit and vegetables, plant-based products, dairy and cheese, pet food, material handling automation, pharmaceuticals and nutraceuticals, and water treatment. Notable references include the adoption of Townsend skinners as a standard in the U.S. meat industry and a long-standing partnership with Marlow Foods for plant-based production.

JBT Marel positions its differentiation on the seamless integration of equipment, software, and lifetime service to help customers produce the most value from the least resources. Its automation strategy addresses labor shortages while improving food safety, and its sustainability focus targets energy and water savings, waste reduction, and better raw-material utilization. The firm emphasizes co-creation with customers through its regional technology centers to develop tailored solutions.

name: TZ Medical Inc
old_description: We improve patient care through innovative medical devices that meet and exceed our customers' expectations.
about:
TZ Medical Inc was founded in 1990 by Tom Tribou in a Portland, Oregon coffee shop. Now headquartered in Tualatin, Oregon, the company began with a two-part philosophy: listen to front-line medical professionals to understand their needs before engineering solutions, and price those solutions at a value level so they reach critical-care providers faster.

The company designs and manufactures a range of single-use and reusable medical devices. Its portfolio includes radial access sheaths such as the Skyline XT™ thin-wall sheath, the Cobra Board radial buttress device, radiation protection systems under the URPro line, cardiac monitoring solutions, the Beata Clasp® medical line organizer, the Pullie™ surgical pannus retractor, anesthesia tube holders, and lead apron racks. Products are sold across the United States and internationally.

TZ Medical serves hospitals, catheterization labs, labor and delivery units, and cardiac monitoring programs. Customers cited in company materials include Abington Jefferson Health, O'Connor Hospital, Providence Newberg Medical Center, The Christ Hospital, and Presence St. Joseph Medical Center in Joliet.

The founding premise remains the company's stated differentiator: ideas originate from clinicians, not internal engineers alone, and pricing is structured to be accessible without tiered purchasing commitments. The company also emphasizes responsive customer service and tailored account support.

name: Tabor Plastics Company
old_description: In 1955, plastics pioneer Carl Tabor founded Tabor Plastics with a dedication to cutting-edge processes for injection molding, customer care, expert problem-solving, and community investment.
about:
Tabor Plastics Company was founded in 1955 by plastics pioneer Carl Tabor in St. Louis, Missouri. The business remains family-run, guided by the founder's original dedication to cutting-edge injection molding processes, customer care, expert problem-solving, and community investment.

The company operates as a full-service custom precision injection molder, offering overmolding, insert molding, mold design optimization, mold maintenance and adjustments, new tooling capabilities (domestic or foreign), packaging, and comprehensive post-molding services. Its facility is continuously updated with the latest equipment and a wide inventory of engineering-grade thermoplastics, though headcount and plant size are not publicly disclosed.

Tabor serves original equipment manufacturers across demanding sectors, including lighting, refrigeration, valves and custom valve fixtures, furniture, shipping fixtures, and handheld fixtures. The company emphasizes its role as a go-to partner for OEMs that require consistent quality and on-time delivery.

Founding values extend beyond the shop floor: Tabor established and sustains the Carl J. Tabor Scholarship at Pittsburg State University and supports St. Louis food banks and women's shelters. Leadership describes the firm as an old-fashioned company more concerned with excellence than profits, backing that stance with guaranteed tolerances of ±0.001 inch and a commitment to deliver parts when customers need them.

name: Tactical Electric
about:
Tactical Electric operates as Tactical Contractors Inc. from its base in New York City, serving all five boroughs with a focus on Downtown Manhattan neighborhoods such as the Financial District, Tribeca, SoHo, Chelsea, and the West Village. The company does not disclose a founding year or founder names in its public materials, describing its tenure only as "a long time" and emphasizing years of experience among its licensed electricians.

The firm provides residential and commercial electrical contracting services, including full rewiring, panel upgrades and repairs, sub-panel installations, lighting design and installation (recessed, track, accent, bathroom, kitchen, dimming systems), troubleshooting, safety inspections, dedicated circuitry for home offices, and outlet installation. It offers 24/7 emergency response and same-day service for urgent issues. No facility size, headcount, or project volume figures are published.

Customers range from apartment and brownstone owners in historic districts to commercial tenants in Midtown and the Financial District. The company works with general contractors on pre-renovation inspections and punch lists, and serves property managers handling lease turnovers. Specific neighborhoods cited include Gramercy, Flatiron, Nolita, the Upper East and West Sides, Battery Park, and the Lower East Side.

Tactical Electric positions itself on professionalism, reliability, and affordability, highlighting clear communication, upfront pricing, and a policy of returning to complete repairs free of charge if an issue is not resolved on the first visit. Its electricians are licensed and insured, and the company stresses safety-first practices such as whole-house surge protection, GFCI and AFCI compliance, and childproof outlets.
